mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE rising > 0.3pp in 3 months) signal pessimism, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite the trigger occurring, or the t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 in the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong growth in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL) and falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) in a late-cycle expansion create favorable conditions for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to outperform baseline in the regime, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) growth indicates healthy supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite rising INDPRO.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high unemployment (UNRATE rising > 0.5pp in 2 months) signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite the trigger occurring, or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (HOUST) both increasing signal strong consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns underperform baseline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment persistence regime (UNRATE > 6%), elevated jobless rates indicate prolonged economic stagnation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE staying above 6% in the regime, or t-test p-value > 0.05.
